title: Building Your Carry-Forward Inventory
concept: An inventory case fills with four categories of portable career assets, then crosses into the learner's next chapter.
visualMetaphor: A structured carry-forward case with four drawers

beats.visual: An empty case and a single question
A ruled inventory sheet slides into the case

beats.purpose: Separate portable assets from old context
beats.visual: Asset cards sort into carry and leave columns
Four drawers lock into the case
A compass marker populates drawer two
Role ties fade while person ties remain
An outsider lens reveals a hidden pattern
The completed drawers stack into one inventory
The full case crosses a threshold toward next
